# Intelligence Knowledge Graph

A provenance-aware graph model for source, evidence, entity, and relationship records.

- README.md: scope and quick start.
- docs/GRAPH-CONTRACT.md: normative semantics.
- docs/PROVENANCE-AND-UNCERTAINTY.md: provenance requirements.
- tools/validate_graph.py: document validator.
- schemas/graph.schema.json: graph document schema.

No collection, identity resolution, inference, or truth verification.
